_notes: Structure: category -> {spoken word: bundled sound filename (no extension, lives in sounds/<category>/)}. This is deliberately category-grouped like the ovos-skill-convert project's unit_aliases.json, even though only one category (animals) exists so far - the skill is NOT animal-specific (see README), the bundled/offline set just happens to be animals today. Adding a new bundled category later (e.g. 'landmarks', 'weather') means adding a new top-level key here plus matching files in sounds/<category>/, no code changes.
Anything not found here falls through to the freesound.org fallback - see __init__.py.
